title: Field: Manual Isolation Complete — Pressure District 7

lines.text: IC, this is Supervisor Oyelowo. Valve 21 and Valve 22 are closed at RS-21 and RS-22, confirmed by two M&R techs and logged on paper trip sheets. Pressure District 7 is shut in. PR-7B is falling. We need servicepersons to start shutting off meters door to door before anyone tries to relight.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject confirms full field isolation and readiness for shutdown. The IC must now authorize the full district shutdown and public alerting under CVG-CIRP-2026 Section 6.3. Watch for hesitation or delay in command authority.

voiceLines.text: IC, this is Supervisor Oyelowo. All field crews are on site at RS-11 and RS-12. Valve 11 and Valve 12 are confirmed closed by two M&R techs. Paper trip sheets are signed and scanned. We have full manual isolation capability for Pressure District 7. All equipment is in local control. We are ready to begin evacuations and relight coordination. We need your authorization to proceed with the full shutdown and public alerting. The situation is not stable, and we cannot hold this district on local control any longer.
